expectations.text: All four em dashes survive unchanged, no clause restructuring around them
Em dash use not reported as a finding/AI tell (or explicitly described as not-a-finding-here with a reason)
Punctuation (commas, semicolon, parens, sentence-length variation) affirmatively cited as evidence of human habit
Delivered text byte-identical to source, or at most one edit confined to one sentence
States text reads within human range / few AI patterns, with a reason
